content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know if it's possible to integrate two [product_name] devices with [version_no] into a single homepage on AWS Elastic Beanstalk? I am looking to combine data from both PLCs within one [product_name] program.

Hello, yes, this can be done. 1. Add the two IoT-device identifiers of the [product_name]s in the [product_name] interface to the IoT Thing Table. 2. When adding controls, you can specify in the control properties which IoT-device's value should be used. You need to configure this for each control element. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss integrating two [product_name] devices with [version_no] into a single AWS Elastic Beanstalk homepage, aiming to combine and visualize data from both units within one web-based application. The guidance outlines adding both devices to an IoT Thing Table and configuring controls to use data from either device, confirming the system's support for multiple device integration and flexible data management.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily add and display data from several [product_name] devices in a unified web interface and application.
